title: Particle Fields
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Particle
learningObjectives: Explain how a Particle class stores per-instance x, y, radius, xSpeed, and ySpeed state so that many particles animate independently from one array
Trace the edge-collision rule that reverses xSpeed or ySpeed when a particle crosses the canvas or drawHeight boundary
Describe how joinParticles() uses dist() against an 85-pixel threshold to draw a line only between nearby particles, producing an emergent network
Apply the two HSB hue sliders to set particle and connecting-line colors independently
